name: Raise A Bloppa 💰
desc:
Bloppa is full of BOMBS.
If you don't feed him, he will explode. 🗿

🐈 Become richer than your arch-rival Floppa.
💰 Buy upgrades that make Blop drop more money!
👨 Bug your roommate for rent so you can feed your Blop.

Join our 💜🎮 server to see what new updates we're working on!

This game is similar to Raise A Floppa.
This game is also similar to Raise Peter.
This is a meme clicker game.
